mechanics_notes: 100-Ki Ki Blast Super from PQ113 Basic Reward. Creates five Buu-shaped ghosts in front of the user; a second input launches them, while leaving them in place for about five seconds also sends them toward the opponent. Current reference reports 5% total damage across five hits; no narrower CaC restriction is established.
evidence_boundary: Current Xenoverse 2-specific identity, mechanics, acquisition and restriction evidence only; unresolved frame/timing details remain bounded.
